entities.summary: Budapest University of Economics and Business (BUEB) is a public business school specializing in business studies and social sciences, located in Budapest, Hungary. It was founded in 1857 by the merchants and bankers of Austria-Hungary. It is the oldest public business school in the world, and the second oldest among all business schools, after the ESCP Business School in Paris.
